svg.desc: Current Repero AI wordmark rendered on a transparent background.

text.style: stroke: none; stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-dashoffset: 0; stroke-linejoin: miter; stroke-miterlimit: 4; fill: rgb(5,10,28); fill-rule: nonzero; opacity: 1; white-space: pre;
